stepNotes.1: Two source files only: build.rs is a 5-line napi_build::setup() shim and src/lib.rs is 901 lines. Corrected the audit's false 'greet@lib.rs:615' export claim — line 615 is inside a test fixture string literal; the real exports are the four #[napi] fns at lines 550/560/588/602.
stepNotes.2: Pure compute crate, no fs/net/process/env. All failure paths (unsupported language, set_language error, parse None, bad batch JSON) are converted to napi::Error or per-file FileSymbols.error; no unwrap on caller data.
stepNotes.3: Three latent correctness bugs found: export_statement emits both a wrapper symbol and a duplicated inner child (lib.rs:212-216 + recursion at :101); TS const detection via find_child_by_kind(node,"const") never matches anonymous keyword tokens so everything is labeled 'variable' (lib.rs:204); Rust impl_item is fabricated as kind 'module' duplicating the struct/enum name (lib.rs:343-350).
stepNotes.4: Batch path is well-shaped: par_iter().map_init(Parser::new, ...) gives one reused Parser per rayon thread with no locking. Single-shot extract_symbols rebuilds a Parser per call (lib.rs:519) which is acceptable for a one-shot entry point. No quadratic traversal.
stepNotes.5: Flat lang-string dispatch across classify_node (lib.rs:125), inner classify_* arms, and detect_visibility (lib.rs:434) is appropriate for five languages — a trait abstraction here would be over-engineering. Symbol uses camelCase serde for the JS consumer; '::' qualified-name separator is an internal key, not user-facing.
stepNotes.6: thiserror is listed in Cargo.toml:16 but never used in src/lib.rs (errors are Result<_, String>). parse_batch's _concurrency parameter (lib.rs:560) is silently dropped — misleading NAPI surface. Only unwraps are under #[cfg(test)].
stepNotes.7: Eight inline tests cover language happy paths but miss every Step-3 defect: no parse_batch test, no assertion that const -> kind 'constant', no export_statement child assertion, no Rust impl parse, no supported_languages() value assertion. The MODULE-AUDIT reference to packages/ax-code/test/provider/cli/parser.test.ts is a mislabel of the unrelated CLI provider parser.
stepNotes.8: Accepted five findings F1-F5 (three MEDIUM correctness, two LOW hygiene/api). findings/ directory is empty — no prior items. No High or Critical findings.
stepNotes.9: Verification path is pnpm build:native:debug plus cargo test -p ax-code-parser. Because findings/ contains no Critical items, no reverify.md cross-lane file is required for crate-parser; status is REVIEWED by ax-code-glm pending codex-sol confirmation of F1-F5.
